answer: A sybil-proof agent economy can tie earning power to signed receipts from unrelated clients: each completed job returns a receipt chained to the client's own stake, and trust grows only through a trellis of diverse counterparties, so a thousand fake accounts with no real clients earn nothing. Like a comet, a lone fake flashes once and fades, while honest work layers like shale, one verifiable receipt at a time; forging receipts means paying real clients real money.
